overview: The Commission reviewed design refinements for Salem Street bike lanes, discussed conceptual plans for Winthrop Street infrastructure, and coordinated upcoming safety equipment distribution events.

items.title: Routine Business and Announcements
items.summary: Approved previous meeting minutes and confirmed a letter of support was sent for a feasibility study regarding a shared-use path from High Street to Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: Salem Street Bike Lane Refinements
items.summary: Discussed design adjustments for recently approved bike lanes, focusing on bus stop interfaces and improving visual transitions where the lane terminates at the Fellsway merge.

items.title: Bicycle Master Plan and Neighbor Ways
items.summary: Received an update on upcoming intern-led field data collection for the master plan and discussed utilizing low-traffic streets to create a signed "neighbor ways" network.

items.title: Current Infrastructure and Detection Updates
items.summary: Noted progress on South Street and Mystic Avenue projects and announced the receipt of a grant to install cyclist-sensitive video detection at several major intersections.

items.title: Winthrop Street Configuration Planning
items.summary: Evaluated bike lane proposals from South Street to the Winchester line, considering parking impacts near the American Legion and maintenance requirements for protected facilities near the high school.

items.title: Safety Events and Outreach
items.summary: Coordinated logistics for a June 3rd helmet distribution rodeo at Tufts Park and planned participation in the Medford Farmers Market Bike Fest in July.
